a: The activation conditions include paying 1 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 3 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 1 cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 1 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 3 Digimon?

Effect: {Hand} [Main] By paying 1 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 3 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜Draw 1＞.
[On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [Legend-Arms] trait in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
